draft.title: Before starting a civil claim
card: A plaintiff is the person who starts a civil claim. Before filing, a plaintiff should weigh up whether the claim is worth pursuing.
Costs
Court cases can cost a lot in legal fees, court fees and time. A plaintiff may also have to pay the defendant's costs if the claim fails.
Time limit
Each type of claim has a limitation period set by law. If the plaintiff starts the claim after it ends, the defendant can ask the court to stop the claim.
Enforcement
A court order is only useful if it can be carried out. If the defendant has no money or assets, the plaintiff may win but never be paid.
draft.remember: Before suing, ask: what will it cost, is there still time, and can a win be enforced?

a.q: Which of these is a reason a plaintiff might decide not to start a civil claim?
opts: The likely legal costs are close to the amount claimed
The defendant has said they disagree with the claim
The plaintiff has never been to court before
The defendant is likely to hire a lawyer
a.why: If costs are close to what the plaintiff could win, the claim may leave them no better off, and they may even pay the defendant's costs if they lose. A defendant disagreeing is normal in a dispute and is not one of the factors on the card.
a.clue: Think about whether winning would leave the plaintiff better off.

b.q: Priya wins a court order that Dan pay her $20,000 for a faulty renovation. Dan has no job, no savings and owns no property. Which factor did Priya fail to weigh before starting her claim?
opts: Whether a win could be enforced against Dan
Whether the limitation period had passed
Whether she had proved her claim
Whether the court fees were affordable
b.why: Priya won, so the problem is not proof. Dan has no money or assets, so the order may not be carried out and she may not be paid. That is the enforcement issue. The time limit is not the issue because the court made the order.
b.clue: She won the case. What could still stop her getting paid?

a.best: The likely legal costs are close to the amount claimed

b.best: Whether a win could be enforced against Dan

problems.detail: The stem assumes Priya 'failed to weigh' enforcement. The scenario only shows that enforcement is a problem. She may have weighed it and sued anyway. Wording such as 'Which factor should Priya have weighed more carefully' would avoid this assumption.
